headline: USANA Health Sciences Misses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: USANA Health Sciences reported quarterly earnings that missed consensus estimates by $0.54, alongside lower-than-expected revenue.
why: USANA Health Sciences is a global direct-selling nutritional products company whose financial health reflects consumer spending trends in wellness.

impacts.name: USANA Health Sciences
impacts.why: Earnings per share and revenue both fell short of Wall Street estimates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Missing both earnings and revenue expectations typically leads to negative price movement in a company's equity.
